mapper.sql: select u.usage_id, u.container_id, c.container_code, c.container_type, u.batch_id, b.batch_no, u.start_time, u.end_time, u.fill_quantity_l, u.remarks, u.del_flag, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time from trace_container_usage u left join trace_container c on c.container_id = u.container_id left join trace_batch b on b.batch_id = u.batch_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from trace_container_usage where batch_id = #{batchId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from trace_container_usage where container_id = #{containerId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
